PluginData.Tooltip: 1.0.4 - Simpler search menu, clearer settings, native key binding and resizable HUD.
PluginData.Description: Learned ore search, configurable pings, optional SDX2 estimates and approximate nearby deposits. Common search controls have one home. Clearer categories and tooltips, ANY / ALL ore matching, one MOVE / RESIZE HUD button and native MENU KEY binding. Search starts off each launch. Windows / Pulsar Legacy.
